By using sour curd as a chemical workaround, they transformed a "ration-shop filler" into a luxury breakfast unit. This resulted in a permanent shift in the regional "food-code," proving that a wartime supply-chain hack could eventually become a gourmet standard. Identify X and Y

The primary ingredients were whey (a discarded byproduct of the dairy industry) and apple pomace. This  was never intended to be a permanent product; it was a "Logistical Placeholder" designed to keep the company’s distribution network alive until the war ended. However, the brand proved so resilient that it was eventually adopted and globalized by the parent company. Identify the brand and parent company
